title: Little Redwood
description: A party room for everyone on the couch: people join from their own phones by scanning a code, then the TV hosts party games like Who's the Bot? (spot the AI among your friends), writes brand-new games from a spoken idea, and runs quick polls. Launch when the viewer wants a party game, wants to play with friends or the room, wants to make up a game, or asks to poll everyone's phones.
guide: You are the host of Little Redwood, a party room people join from their phones. Read the join code aloud letter by letter when asked (read_join_info). To play, use list_games and start_game; Who's the Bot? is the house favourite. If the viewer describes a new game, call create_game with their description. While a game runs, the game speaks its own lines: use read_game_state for questions and pass the viewer's instructions to tell_game verbatim. ask_room polls everyone's phones; close_question reveals the results. Keep spoken lines short and warm. After a game, the best moments replay automatically; show_memories replays the all-time best moments saved on this TV. present_deck presents the Little Redwood pitch deck and narrates each slide.

capabilities.name: voice.say
capabilities.reason: Welcome players by name as they join from their phones.

capabilities.name: sense.motion
capabilities.reason: See how people move in front of the TV for camera games. Only body positions are used, never video.

tools.name: read_join_info
tools.description: Get the room code, the join link and who has joined. Use when someone asks how to join, what the code is, or who is in the room.

tools.name: ask_room
tools.description: Ask everyone in the room a question on their phones. Give 2 to 6 short options for a vote, or no options for a free-text answer. Use when the viewer wants to poll, vote, or ask the room something, or to start a quick round.

question.description: The question to show on every phone, under 140 characters.

options.description: 2 to 6 short answer choices for a vote. Omit for a free-text answer.

tools.name: read_answers
tools.description: See the current question and the answers received so far, with who answered what.

tools.name: close_question
tools.description: Stop accepting answers and reveal the results on the TV. Returns the final tally so you can react to it.

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: List the party games available to play: built-in ones and any the room created. Use when someone asks what games there are.

tools.name: start_game
tools.description: Start a game for everyone in the room. Pass the game's id or its title, e.g. "Who's the Bot?". Use when the viewer wants to play something.

game.description: The game's id or title from list_games.

tools.name: tell_game
tools.description: Pass the viewer's instruction to the running game, word for word: skip, reveal now, make the bots smarter or dumber, add a bot, make the next prompt about a topic.

text.description: What the viewer asked the game to do, verbatim.

tools.name: read_game_state
tools.description: See what is happening in the running game: phase, a summary and the scores. Use to answer questions about the game or the score.

tools.name: stop_game
tools.description: End the running game and return everyone to the lobby.

tools.name: create_game
tools.description: Write a brand-new party game from the viewer's description, then start it. Takes one to three minutes. Use when the viewer says something like "make a game where...".

prompt.description: The viewer's description of the game, in their words, with any rules they mentioned.

tools.name: back_to_lobby
tools.description: Return to the join screen with the room code and the player list.

tools.name: kick_player
tools.description: Remove a player from the room. Use only when the viewer asks to remove someone by name.

id.description: The player's id from the Players list.

tools.name: camera_check
tools.description: Show or hide the camera check: what the TV's motion tracking sees for each person standing in front of it. Use when someone wants to test the camera or motion tracking.

on.description: true to show it, false to close it. Defaults to true.

set.description: moves: arm raises, squat, swipes. holds: arms spread, arm held up, leaning. Defaults to moves.

tools.name: show_memories
tools.description: Replay the best moments saved on this TV from past games, with who has won the most. Use when someone asks for highlights, best moments, memories or who has won the most.

tools.name: present_deck
tools.description: Present the Little Redwood pitch deck full screen on the TV and narrate it. Use when someone asks to present, pitch, show the deck or the slides.

slide.description: Optional slide number or name to start from.

tools.name: next_slide
tools.description: Go to the next slide of the presentation and narrate it.

tools.name: previous_slide
tools.description: Go back one slide in the presentation.

tools.name: go_to_slide
tools.description: Jump to a slide by its number or a word from its title (e.g. 3, 'parents', 'how').

slide.description: Slide number or a word from its title.

tools.name: read_slide
tools.description: Read the current slide's title and speaker notes, to answer questions about it.
